item.result:
Agent completed in 29.7s (7 tool uses, 18.2k token).

All eight extensions are under `/Users/andraspalasti/.pi/agent/extensions/`. None uses `registerTool`, `registerShortcut`, `registerFlag`, `registerProvider`, `registerMcpServer` or `appendEntry`.

**git-diffstat/** (~350 lines across `index.ts`, `branch-picker.ts`, `tree.ts`, `view.ts`; self-contained)
- It adds a `/diffstat` command that picks a base branch and shows a tree view of the diffstat against the current branch.
- It uses `pi.registerCommand("diffstat")`, `pi.exec("git", …)`, `ctx.ui.custom(...)` for the picker and viewer, and `ctx.ui.notify`.
- It registers no `pi.on` events and persists nothing.

**herdr-agent-state.ts** (395 lines; single file, auto-installed by herdr and marked "do not edit")
- It reports the agent's state (working, idle, blocked, error) to the herdr terminal multiplexer over a Unix socket.
- Events: `session_start`, `agent_start`, `agent_end`, `session_shutdown`. It also listens on the extension event bus with `pi.events.on("herdr:blocked")`.
- It reads the env vars `HERDR_ENV`, `HERDR_SOCKET_PATH` and `HERDR_PANE_ID`, plus other env-based tunables, and writes JSON lines to the socket. It uses a regex to classify retryable errors such as 429 and 5xx.
- It is a no-op when not running inside herdr.

**issues/** (~330 lines in `index.ts` and `picker.ts`, plus `orchestrate.md`; self-contained)
- It adds `/orchestrate`, which scans `.scratch/` in the git root for open issue markdown files with frontmatter. You pick them in a multi-select, and it fills the editor with an orchestrator prompt built from `orchestrate.md`.
- It uses `registerCommand("orchestrate")`, `pi.exec("git", ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])`, `ctx.ui.select`, `ctx.ui.input`, `ctx.ui.setEditorText` and `ctx.ui.notify`. `picker.ts` is a custom `MultiSelectComponent`.
- It reads files only and registers no events.

**paste-detector/** (125 lines plus a README; self-contained, needs `rg` installed)
- It detects pasted multi-line code and, if ripgrep finds it in the codebase, replaces it with `[Found in path:lines]`.
- Event: `session_start`, where it calls `ctx.ui.setEditorComponent(...)` to install a custom editor subclass that intercepts paste.
- It also uses `pi.exec("rg", …)`, `ui.setEditorText` and `ui.notify`.
- It persists nothing. The README says `setup.sh` symlinks it into place.

**pi-tool-display/** (`config.json` only, 28 lines)
- There is no source file. The config belongs to a separate pi-tool-display package that was not found inside this directory.
- It enables compact rendering overrides for read, grep, find, ls, bash, edit and write, with summary or count output modes, a diff view and bars.
- It is not self-contained. The code must come from an installed package.

**session-name/** (~630 lines in `index.ts`, `naming.ts`, `eval.ts`; self-contained)
- It auto-names sessions after the first exchange, or on load for resumed sessions that never got a name. It uses an LLM or a heuristic, and `/rename` regenerates the name.
- Events: `session_start`, `session_info_changed`, `agent_settled`, `session_shutdown`.
- It uses `registerCommand("rename")`, `pi.setSessionName`, `ctx.sessionManager.getBranch()`, `ctx.modelRegistry` (`find`, `getApiKeyAndHeaders`, `getProvider`), and `ctx.ui.setWidget("session-name", …, {placement:"aboveEditor"})`.
- It reads its config from `~/.pi/agent/configs/session-name.json`, and the heuristic can read a heading from a referenced markdown file.
- `eval.ts` is a standalone offline eval script. It reads `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` and calls `https://ollama.com/v1/chat/completions`, using `SN_MODEL` and `SN_N`.

**watch-pr/** (835 lines plus a README; self-contained, needs `az` CLI and network)
- It polls an Azure DevOps PR every 60s by default (minimum 15s) for failed build policies, failed status checks and unresolved comment threads. New items are sent to the agent as a fix prompt.
- It registers `/watch-pr` with the forms `<pr-url|repo-url> [seconds]`, `status` and `stop [id|all]`. With no URL it uses a live-search picker of active PRs.
- Event: `session_shutdown`, which clears the watches.
- It uses `pi.sendUserMessage(prompt, {deliverAs:"followUp"})`, `ctx.ui.setWidget`, `ctx.ui.setStatus("watch-pr", …)`, `ctx.ui.select`, `ctx.ui.notify` and `pi.exec` for `git remote`.
- It calls the Azure DevOps REST API v7.1 with `fetch` and an AAD token from `az account get-access-token`, and retries with the tenant from `X-VSS-ResourceTenant`.
- The "seen" set is in memory only, so watches are session-scoped.

**wayfinder/** (278 lines in `index.ts`, plus prompt templates `chart.md`, `grilling.md`, `handoff.md`, `map-bookkeeping.md`, `prototype.md`, `research.md`, `seam.md`, `task.md`; self-contained)
- It adds `/wayfinder`, which finds "efforts" (a map plus tickets with frontmatter such as type, status, blockedBy and claimed). You pick an effort or ticket, or enter a new idea, and it loads the matching template into the editor.
- It uses `registerCommand("wayfinder")`, `ctx.ui.select`, `ctx.ui.input`, `ctx.ui.setEditorText`, `ctx.ui.notify` and `pi.exec("git", ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])`.
- It reads files only and registers no events.

**Events used across all extensions:** `session_start`, `agent_start`, `agent_end`, `agent_settled`, `session_info_changed`, `session_shutdown`, and the event-bus event `herdr:blocked`. `tool_call` and `before_agent_start` are not used anywhere.

**Slash commands:** `/diffstat`, `/orchestrate`, `/rename`, `/watch-pr`, `/wayfinder`.
